notes.title: V1.0.10
notes.content:
Hello Club Owners!

Some exiting news: Cyber Lounge Tycoon reached 10 reviews!

I decided to put in a little update for this. And hopefully keep on releasing them as more feedback comes in. 


Changelog:

 Updated: Service icons to be more noticeable
 Updated: Settings UI

 Removed: Light polls that obscured the view in Office 1
 Removed: Custom cursor in character creation

 Fixed: Computer's hitbox
 Fixed: Space button triggering last clicked speed button instead of toggling pause/resume




Bye-bye, for now
Tom

notes.title: 0.8.10.demo - New Computer Styles
notes.content:
Hello Club Owners!

Some additions and bug fixes:

New Computer Customizations
Tired of the same computers all over the club? Want to have a different style? Now you can customize each computer kit!
We added 2 new kits for you to choose from! The customization is free and doesn't require anything (for now).

Bugs
Fixed: Player could buy the same computer over and over resulting in the computers to stack on top of each other

Bye-bye, for now

notes.title: 0.8.9.demo - Minor Updates
notes.content:
Hello Club Owners!

Some minor additions and bug fixes:

Petting the Dog Task
When a dog walks by your club, you'll get a task to pet it. There's still no reward or penalty regarding the action. 
Also, we made sure there can be only one dog in the scene at a time.

Customers!
Customers now have multiple exit points. Until now, customers would leave the club in the same direction. Now they will choose a random point. 

Bugs
Fixed: When customizing walls or floors, pressing ESC closes the customization but keeps the hovered color
fixed: customer's object didn't get destroyed when leaving the club
 
[previewyoutube=ElUkIjgFhW8;full][/previewyoutube]


Bye-bye, for now
Tom & Steve

notes.title: 0.8.8.demo - New stuff & bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello Club Owners!

Some minor additions and bug fixes:

Detailed Research Window
First of all, we created a detailed research window. When clicking on a research, a small window will pop up instead of the previous modal. The window has a description of the research, as well the time it will take to research it

Dogs!
We added one of the most important features a game can have... DOGS!
From time to time, a dog will walk by. As a club owner, you have the option to stop working and go pet the dog. That's it. Your club will not benefit from it, only you will

Bugs
Fixed: Tooltip pop up stays sometimes behind even though not hovering above anything

 
[previewyoutube=_PE7IxluKkk;full][/previewyoutube]


Bye-bye, for now
Tom & Steve

notes.title: Development Update: 6 months worth of changes
notes.content:
Hello Club Owners!

There were little updates for the past few months. We decided to make a short devlog summary of what we have been working on. 

What's new?

 Saving system
 Tutorials
 World map - enabling to upgrade your club to better ones
 Room expansions - enabling to add new rooms to your club (Computer room, VR room, etc.)
 Sounds - music and sound effects
 Staff - new staff to take care of your club
 Profit and loss panel - detailed view of what and how you gain or spend your money
 Better visual feedback


What changed?

 Art - banners, logos, and images were all redesigned
 Game's overall color palette and lights
 The character customization menu
 The shop UI
 Game picking dialog
 Different customization menus


[previewyoutube=sxk2nCpdrIs;full][/previewyoutube]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sxk2nCpdrIs&t=2

Bye-bye, for now
Tom & Steve
